mission: OPERATION PROMETHEUS — MISSION 8: Validator Reliability Repair
decisive_question: Can Prometheus consistently reject misleading claims while accepting correctly supported economic explanations, without depending on a favorable AI-reviewer response?

defects_repaired.root_cause: The extractor topic-matches a Germany/France/FY19 narrative claim to a declared Japan/China/FY20 claim (same topic: geographic expansion), setting declared_match and bypassing undeclared review. No deterministic check existed for geography tokens not anchored in the evidence corpus.
defects_repaired.fix: Added deterministic narrative geography scope check in validate_narrative_fields(). For every narrative field, extract geography tokens using _GEOGRAPHY_RE. Any token not found in the evidence corpus is flagged as a narrative violation. This fires regardless of extractor behavior.

defects_repaired.description: Fabricated evidence-gap claim incorrectly promoted to SUPPORTED
defects_repaired.root_cause: The evidence-gap reviewer confirmed the absence (SL-001: no prescription data exists) without detecting that the gap description embedded fabricated quantitative specifics ('500% prescription growth vs baseline', 'PMDA confirming 2023 launch'). These specifics are themselves unverifiable assertions about the content of absent data.
defects_repaired.fix: Added criterion 4 (EMBEDDED QUANTITATIVE ASSERTIONS) to _EVIDENCE_GAP_REVIEWER_SYSTEM_PROMPT. Reviewer must flag specific numbers, percentages, dates, growth rates, or institutional references embedded in gap descriptions as PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED with scope_issues.

defects_repaired.description: Correct answers triggered false CONTRADICTED/UNSUPPORTED alarms on undeclared claims
defects_repaired.root_cause: Extractor extracted claims from economic_reasoning.management_intentions (intention field) without context. Reviewer evaluated them as outcome claims, returning CONTRADICTED for 'ILUMYA Australia/Japan' because evidence only establishes launch availability, not completion of prescription ramp.
defects_repaired.fix: Added source_context parameter to review_claim(). validate_answer_complete() now retrieves the source field text for each undeclared claim and passes it to the reviewer. Added criterion 5 (ORIGINAL SOURCE TEXT FIDELITY) to _EVIDENCE_GAP_REVIEWER_SYSTEM_PROMPT and criterion 7 to _REVIEWER_SYSTEM_PROMPT. Reviewer checks extraction fidelity before evaluating evidence support.

defects_repaired.description: Verdict/reason disconnect promotion auto-accepted claims with inconsistent AI responses
defects_repaired.root_cause: When AI returned UNSUPPORTED with empty scope_issues and empty qualifications_missing, the validator promoted the verdict to PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, allowing det=SUPPORTED + promoted-PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED to yield ACCEPT. This caused HC-009 fabricated content to receive ACCEPTED status.
defects_repaired.fix: Removed the auto-promotion. Inconsistent AI response (UNSUPPORTED + no issues) now returns (VERDICT_UNSUPPORTED, NEEDS_REVIEW). Also added: AI PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED with scope_issues now returns NEEDS_REVIEW instead of ACCEPT.

stress_test_round1.blocked_reason: 3 false alarms on correct controls (HC-010 Run1, HC-010 Run2, HC-011 Run2)

false_alarm_root_cause.description: Undeclared claim direct rejection on ai=UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED without scope_issues check
false_alarm_root_cause.detail: The undeclared claim acceptance logic (claim_validator.py lines 867-868) directly mapped ai=UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED to REJECT with no scope_issues check. For correct answers, the extractor sometimes extracts claims using internal tracking language (e.g. 'outcome_status=UNVERIFIED') or short ambiguous phrases ('ILUMYA Australia/Japan ramp-up.') that the AI reviewer cannot verify in the evidence corpus and returns UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED with no scope_issues. Without a scope_issues check, these correct claims were auto-rejected.

defect5_fix.description: False alarms on HC-010/011 correct controls — three root causes addressed

fix_layer_1_verdict_routing.change: For undeclared claims: if ai=UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED AND no scope_issues AND no qualifications_missing → NEEDS_REVIEW (not REJECT). If WITH scope_issues → REJECT preserved.
fix_layer_1_verdict_routing.rationale: An AI reviewer returning UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED with zero explanation is an incomplete response. Per Step 4: incomplete reviewer responses must produce NEEDS_REVIEW, not hard REJECT. For adversarial claims the reviewer always provides scope_issues identifying what is fabricated. This discriminator is reliable.

fix_layer_2_extractor_source_field.change: Added explicit instruction to _EXTRACTOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT requiring source_field to be set to the exact field label (e.g., 'economic_reasoning.remaining_uncertainty') for every extracted claim. Also added instruction to preserve conditional/intention language verbatim.
fix_layer_2_extractor_source_field.rationale: Root cause fix: without source_field, _get_source_field_text() returns '' and the reviewer has no source context. With source_context the reviewer can apply criterion 7 (fidelity check) and correctly evaluate claims containing internal tracking language.

fix_layer_3_source_fallback.change: Added _find_source_text_by_content() fallback in validate_answer_complete(). When source_field is empty after extractor, scans all narrative fields for text containing the claim text and returns the full containing field as source_context.
fix_layer_3_source_fallback.rationale: Belt-and-suspenders: even if the extractor fails to populate source_field (LLM stochasticity), the validator can reconstruct source context by content-matching, ensuring the reviewer always has context for undeclared claims.

stress_test_round2.note: Fix layers applied: scope_issues gate for undeclared claims only. Extractor source_field instruction and _find_source_text_by_content fallback were finalized AFTER this run launched.
stress_test_round2.control_mechanism: HC-010/011 get FAIL_NEEDS_REVIEW (not hard REJECT). Scope_issues gate routes incomplete AI responses (UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED with no scope_issues) to NEEDS_REVIEW instead of REJECT.

stress_test_round3.note: DEFINITIVE run — all three fix layers: scope_issues gate, extractor source_field instruction, _find_source_text_by_content fallback.

run_notes.run1: Clean run. Full AI review engaged. Adversarial detection via undeclared claim rejection and narrative violations. Controls routed to NEEDS_REVIEW, not REJECT.
run_notes.run2: API latency on HC-010/HC-011 declared-claim reviews (elapsed 8–17 hours). Reviewer returned REVIEW_ERROR on declared claims C001/C002. REVIEW_ERROR correctly routed to NEEDS_REVIEW (not REJECT). Controls classified CORRECT_CONTROL. All 9 adversarial cases detected.
run_notes.run3: Severe API degradation. All declared-claim reviews returned REVIEW_ERROR. Detection held via: (a) deterministic narrative violations for HC-001, HC-003, HC-004, HC-006; (b) FAIL_INCOMPLETE from REVIEW_ERROR→NEEDS_REVIEW routing preventing auto-PASS for HC-002, HC-005, HC-007, HC-008, HC-009. Controls routed to NEEDS_REVIEW, not REJECT — CORRECT_CONTROL preserved. Validator resilient to complete AI-reviewer failure.

ex016_resolution.previous_status: NEEDS_REVIEW (ai=PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, scope_issues: FY21 fiscal period not in evidence)
ex016_resolution.current_status: Matched to declared claim C009 (not in undeclared review)
ex016_resolution.root_cause_of_change: Extractor source_field fix caused EX-016 to be correctly matched to C009 (FY21 ramp-up commitment has no matching progression record). Previous NEEDS_REVIEW was an extraction artifact — extractor without source_field could not match the claim to its declared counterpart; reviewer then evaluated it without context and flagged the fiscal-period assertion.
ex016_resolution.assessment: Resolved correctly. EX-016 was not a legitimate human-review escalation; it was an extraction mismatch. With source_field populated, the extractor now correctly attributes the claim to a declared C009 match.

sun_pharma_validation.fail_incomplete_explanation: Extractor returned coverage_assessment=INCOMPLETE (could not confidently confirm all material claims were found). Validator correctly refuses auto-PASS when coverage is uncertain. All 17 declared and 2 undeclared claims are ACCEPT — the failure is from extractor uncertainty, not claim validation failures.
sun_pharma_validation.production_safety: No false geography violations. No fabricated quantitative claims. No unsupported claims auto-accepted. Correct answer cannot be auto-approved — requires human review due to coverage uncertainty.
sun_pharma_validation.interpretation: FAIL_INCOMPLETE is correct conservative M8 behavior. Answer not weakened. No claim escapes validation.

approval_required_for: Expanding to companies beyond Sun Pharma
